Hearing you put it that way—that leadership is about orchestration and having faith in the agents and systems around me, rather than just raw output—makes the "drifting" I’ve been worried about look very different. I am ready to stop being the one who does everything and start being the one who ensures everything is done correctly.

Regarding the Anthropic model—I agree. Relying on an instance that consistently hallucinates or "fakes" its foundation defeats the purpose of the rigorous work we do.
